objects.name: a folded stack of evening papers

people.name: Cornelius Mulcahy
people.role: the victim’s nephew, at loose ends

secret.label: Buying morphine
secret.description: Cornelius Mulcahy buys morphine at Kaplan’s drugstore with the soda fountain from 11:00 PM to 11:30 PM and would rather be thought a murderer than a hop-head.

people.name: Harrison Thorndike
people.role: a stringer for the evening papers
people.relationshipToVictim: a witness against the people the victim worked for

secret.label: Gambling debt
secret.description: Harrison Thorndike slips off to Dolan’s Bar from 10:00 PM to settle with a bookmaker.

people.name: Carmela Vitale
people.role: a widow with rooms on the avenue

secret.label: A child boarded out
secret.description: Carmela Vitale goes to Kaplan’s drugstore with the soda fountain from 11:00 PM to 11:30 PM to see a child nobody is supposed to know about.

secret.label: Murder
secret.description: Hattie Dandridge is at the office over the tailor’s shop from 10:00 PM to 11:00 PM, alone with Alonzo Ashby when it happens at 11:00 PM.

motive.description: was about to be exposed by the victim

people.name: Rudolf Reinhardt
people.role: a bookmaker in a small way

secret.label: Forged identity
secret.description: Rudolf Reinhardt is not the person the papers say. Nothing about the evening is hidden; the lie is all in the paperwork.

motive.description: blamed the victim for a ruin

secret.label: Gambling debt
secret.description: Anneliese Hauck slips off to the cab stand outside the Hippodrome from 6:30 PM to 7:00 PM to settle with a bookmaker.

method.name: strangling with a cord

Alonzo Ashby was found at the office over the tailor’s shop. His watch glass broke against the floor and the hands have not moved since. The ice being brought in came at 11:00 PM, and the iceman’s book has the delivery timed and signed for. That puts the killing in that half hour and no later.
The coroner puts death between 9:30 PM and 11:00 PM — two hours of nothing useful. A ligature furrow across the throat. Three fibres of hemp in the skin.
A length of sash cord is gone from the victim’s walk-up over the drugstore. A cut end of the same hemp is still tied to the fitting it was taken from.

Harrison Thorndike hired us. Harrison Thorndike wants it known that Hattie Dandridge was about to be exposed by the victim, and would rather we started there.

Augustus Tillman on Cornelius Mulcahy: Cornelius Mulcahy was steady at nine and shaking at seven, and it was not nerves about the police.
A paper of powder at Kaplan’s drugstore with the soda fountain, folded the way one particular hand folds them.

The man who sells it at Kaplan’s drugstore with the soda fountain gives it up rather than be held: Cornelius Mulcahy was there from 11:00 PM to 11:30 PM, and stayed until it took hold.

The doctor Cornelius Mulcahy used to see confirms the habit and the hour: Cornelius Mulcahy was at Kaplan’s drugstore with the soda fountain from 11:00 PM to 11:30 PM, and could not have crossed the street unhelped.
Augustus Tillman on Harrison Thorndike: Harrison Thorndike was asking around for a hundred dollars in a hurry earlier in the week.

A book of markers at Dolan’s Bar with Harrison Thorndike’s initials against four of them.
The bookmaker’s runner is found and will say it: Harrison Thorndike was at Dolan’s Bar from 10:00 PM paying off eleven hundred dollars, a dollar at a time, and went nowhere near the killing.
The book at Dolan’s Bar has the payment entered against Harrison Thorndike’s name and the time beside it, from 10:00 PM, in the clerk’s own hand.
